prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: orthographic game-model texture projection source; flat albedo painting.
Input image 1 is the exact geometry guide and edit target. Input image 2 is the approved design reference, used ONLY for its materials, colours and surface design, NEVER its camera angle, outline, proportions or pose.
Paint the supplied guide in place. Preserve the guide's silhouette EXACTLY, identical outline, scale, orientation, position, every part edge, cutout and gap. Do not rotate, recenter, enlarge, move, reshape or replace any part. Do not invent new geometry or parts outside the guide. Preserve even its angular facets and small irregularities. One object, same 1024 x 1024 square canvas as the guide, transparent background, no cropping.
Apply only the reference's actual materials: warm ivory-white ceramic armour with fine subtle hairline wear, restrained fine seams/panel joins, brushed ochre-gold trim, black-violet resin at exposed mechanical joints and connectors, and ruby-red crystal with red-orange luminous veins where its gem surfaces are visible. The reference's RED crystal colour is authoritative; do not introduce blue light. No leather, cloth or paper where the reference does not show them. Continue those same materials plausibly over unseen rear and underside surfaces. Keep the surface design coherent and restrained.
LIGHTING: this is an ALBEDO TEXTURE SOURCE, not a beauty render. Flat even shadowless lighting from the viewer. Remove the guide's baked shading. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no directional gradients or dark corners, no rim lighting, no hot white highlights, no reflected lights or environment, no bright metallic reflections. Metals read as solid ochre-gold base colour with at most a faint sheen. Crystals read as deep ruby red with bright red-orange vein colour, no glow halo or bloom beyond their surface. No floor or background. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or labels.
VIEW-SPECIFIC GEOMETRY: FRONT view, paint guide_front.png exactly as it is. Its sharp central apex points UP near (512,163), both hooked mechanical appendages occupy the UPPER corners, and its broad plain underbody tapers to a lower point near (512,860). The central plain shell has no large oval socket visible in this view: continue ivory ceramic back/underside plates with restrained gold seams and a dark resin joint at the appendage collars. Do not move the reference's large jewel onto an invisible socket. Preserve the guide's raised angular chevron ridge and all existing borders. The guide orientation takes priority over what the word front might suggest.
reason: Rejected: changed frame scale and part contours, added geometric detailing, metallic highlights and ceramic shading; use one corrective regeneration.
